summary: Validated mobile portrait (390x844) HUD refactor + desktop non-regression for Bus-A-Lead. All 3 target fixes VERIFIED via bounding-box comparisons and live card-tap gameplay. Mobile action-bar sits at ~16% viewport top (y=135, bottom=286) with kitty-pile at y=387 (clean gap, no overlap). mobile-g2-bar renders as a compact pill at y=52 (top of viewport, height 38px), does NOT intersect player-hand (y=489-844). Player hand uses 4 suit columns (S/H/D/C) all within 0-390px width, no overflow. Card tap in Spades column registered a state change confirming pointer-events-auto works and no invisible overlay blocks taps. Desktop 1920x800: mobile-g2-bar absent, seat-books-P visible, action-bar renders centrally, deal/bid/pass/play flow works.

issues: seat-books-P element still returns is_visible()=True in DOM on mobile (390x844). Visually the bottom-left dock does not appear in screenshots (likely opacity/pointer-events or offscreen positioning), but for cleanliness main agent may want to add `hidden md:flex` (or `!isMobile && ...`) at the element level so it is fully removed from the DOM/layout on mobile. Not blocking — no visible overlap detected.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Ensure seat-books-P dock is not rendered (or explicitly display:none) on mobile — currently is_visible() returns true though visually not overlapping.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile HUD refactor is clean: action-bar responsive top-[16%] sm:top-[40%] correctly positions above kitty on mobile (y=135) while remaining centered on desktop (y=320).
player-hand z-30 pointer-events-auto verified — card tap on bottom-most Spade produced DOM state change on G2's turn.
Consider gating the desktop bottom dock render behind !isMobile explicitly rather than relying on Tailwind hidden utility to fully remove seat-books-P from mobile DOM.
